historicalProvenance.notes: Astra single-pass direct reading of all three distinct question pages, all six shared English solution pages, all three grading pages, the SNR data page, all three constants/reference pages and the HR diagram. Shared source pages read once and bound to identical document hashes; no separate checker. All six original problem IDs and native question parts retained. Missing figures and all supplied solutions/criteria recovered; relevant native reference tables retained in the English edition. The HR sheet is marked beta and is displayed only in beta problem 3. Printed common grading points are additional to subpart allocations: 2 points for each of problems 4 and 6, and 1.5 points for beta problem 1. Thus those subpart sums are intentionally below 8. Alpha problem 3 is printed entirely as subparts with no introductory statement. Every final actual crop (6 alpha, 9 beta) was personally inspected, including repeated images; all crops used --no-snap. The three standalone grading PNGs have exactly the same decoded RGB bytes as the images embedded in their corresponding PDF sheets.
